generation.scope: At rank ten, a four-middle-support branching center followed by a twisted cubic has exactly two forms for the restriction to its first line and second cubic, and forces a forward center on that cubic. The third curve has degree at most four. If nonplanar, it lies on a smooth quadric with projection degrees 1 and d3-1 and is followed by a moving plane curve through whose plane the original center passes, of degree at least d3-1. This excludes every (1,3,3,1) corridor with twisted cubic inner curves and either endpoint of full middle support.

open_mathematics: Treat a second conic for a rank-ten four-support branching center, use the forced pure relation and incidence of the next center from the twisted cubic case. For the finite reduced branch resolve the unequal symmetric triples in the one-symmetric rank-ten chart, and extend the five-space secant argument to thickened graphs.
